name: Smoke test 5 min scope FFT tb 0.1
description: SMOKE TEST of the scope-FFT storage (2026-10-27): verifies that /sweeps/sweep_NNN/FFT is read from the scope's own FFT math display and stored on every sweep, alongside UL/AE/SP. No scope_fft key, so the FFT is left exactly as set on the front panel (Kim's setting). TIMEBASE 0.1 s, Kim's own front-panel setting (2026-10-27): with the scope FFT on, the scope returns 62,500 points per channel over the whole window regardless, so the FFT's bandwidth follows the timebase - 0.2 s gives 0-156 kHz, 0.1 s gives 0-312 kHz. Same schedule as N0054. UL volt_range 0.4 V (was 12.0): measured 2026-10-27 at 2963 rpm the UL750 output is now only ~0.019 V rms / ~0.1 Vpp (energy at 5.5-6 kHz) against 0.0010 V rms at rest - about 80x below the 1.5 V rms of 2026-10-20 - so at 12 V it spans ~6 ADC levels and is lost in quantisation. 0.4 V gives ~50 levels at full speed with ~4x headroom. If the UL level is restored (sensitivity dial / supply), 0.4 V will clip: re-size.
